images.description: Publication and pulls are distinct from provisioning the registry

steps.detail: CD publishes images separately; the registry root does not build application images.
The Foundry project identity pulls the agent image; it is not the agent runtime identity.
Container Apps pulls with a separate user-assigned identity, unavailable to application code.
